files.token-1-mtp-hprev.f32: the target hidden after position 0, fed as h to the position-1 row
files.token-1-mtp-h.f32: the head's h_nextn at position 1 (nextn.post_projection of the output_norm'd hidden)

note: Captured on Metal with an F32 cache and flash attention off, one token per decode. The assistant context shares the target's layer-40 (sliding) and layer-41 (global) KV caches, which the target's own reuse maps to layers 22 and 23, and writes none of its own; each row was captured before the target decoded that position. The target hidden is the output_norm-applied final hidden (llama_get_embeddings_nextn).
